source:
Standalone slime tycoon lake V8 CARNIVAL SLIME PIT. Name: DeepLake_V8_CarnivalPit. HOLLOW open shaft, center MUST be empty air, only rim+walls+ledges solid. ~100 studs deep, 40 wide.

DENSE OBSTACLES: 10+ props jutting inward across whole depth - floating balloon clusters, swinging ferris wheel gear arm, striped tent pole obstacles, confetti-covered ledge chokepoints, hanging prize ribbon, popcorn cart platform, spinning carousel fragment, ticket booth ledge.

Rim = red/white striped circus tent panels and poles ring the top, bright SmoothPlastic, NO natural rock/grass.
Shallow walls = bubblegum-pink slime coating, floating balloon obstacles.
Mid walls = tent-flap cave openings INTO walls, ferris wheel gear arm across shaft, popcorn cart platform.
Deep walls = carousel fragment ledges jutting in, colorful Neon light-bulb string obstacles.
Abyss = solid floor only at bottom, deep purple slime floor, glowing prize-treasure Slime Vault, confetti particle glow.

Festive Roblox tycoon low-poly, chunky primitives, vivid carnival colors. Folders: Rim, Shallow, Mid, Deep, Abyss, Water.
scene_prompt: Create a standalone festive low-poly Roblox tycoon map named DeepLake_V8_CarnivalPit: a hollow, open carnival slime shaft approximately 40 studs wide and 100 studs deep, with the center kept entirely empty air and only the surrounding rim, walls, and inward-jutting ledges solid. A red-and-white striped circus-tent rim of bright SmoothPlastic panels and poles circles the top, with no natural rock or grass. Bubblegum-pink slime coats the shallow walls amid floating balloon clusters; mid-depth walls contain tent-flap cave openings, a swinging ferris-wheel gear arm spanning the shaft, and a popcorn-cart platform. Deep walls carry carousel-fragment ledges and colorful Neon light-bulb string obstacles. Arrange more than ten dense inward obstacles across the full depth, including striped tent-pole barriers, confetti-covered ledge chokepoints, hanging prize ribbons, ticket-booth ledges, and spinning carousel pieces. At the abyss bottom, place the only solid floor: deep-purple slime surrounding a glowing prize-treasure Slime Vault with confetti glow. Organize the layout into Rim, Shallow, Mid, Deep, Abyss, and Water areas.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation, identified as a tycoon by the author’s original message. There is no secondary genre; carnival styling does not change the tycoon classification.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-underground`, taken from Simulation’s usual shapes: this is a vertical surface-to-abyss facility, with the tented rim at the surface and the Slime Vault at the bottom. The closest preset is none: the shaft’s hollow carnival descent is unlike the Mining & Extraction preset’s shared mine and uses none of its resource-field or vehicle-route assumptions.

### Config requirements
No image config options apply beyond the described geometry. Do not add natural terrain, water, resource fields, roads, or generic tycoon structures; the named Water area is organizational only and does not imply visible water.

### Layout requirements
No placed layout options are specified. Do not infer task stations, purchase gates, resource nodes, or collectible placement from the tycoon label alone.

### Layout components
Build one approximately 40-stud-wide, 100-stud-deep hollow open shaft. Keep its central column entirely empty air; only the circular top rim, enclosing walls, and inward-projecting ledges are solid. Organize geometry folders/zones as Rim, Shallow, Mid, Deep, Abyss, and Water. The Rim is a continuous top ring of bright SmoothPlastic red-and-white striped circus tent panels and poles, with no rock or grass. Shallow walls are bubblegum-pink slime with floating balloon clusters. Mid walls contain tent-flap cave openings, a swinging ferris-wheel gear arm spanning across the void, and a popcorn-cart platform. Deep walls use carousel-fragment ledges, colorful Neon bulb-string obstacles, striped tent-pole barriers, confetti-covered ledge chokepoints, hanging prize ribbons, ticket-booth ledges, and spinning carousel pieces. Distribute more than ten inward-jutting obstacle props across the full depth without filling the central void. The Abyss contains the only solid floor: deep-purple slime surrounding a glowing prize-treasure Slime Vault with confetti glow. The boundary is the shaft’s continuous carnival-coated wall cylinder, open only at the top. Compose the isometric view from above the rim so the full vertical void, layered depth bands, and bottom vault remain legible.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the dramatic vertical carnival shaft and its empty central air column are the authoritative visual composition; stacked capture handling resolves the overhanging ledges afterward.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium: the footprint is compact but the 100-stud vertical build has dense full-depth dressing. Theme: vivid festive low-poly Roblox carnival, chunky primitives, SmoothPlastic slime, striped circus elements, and Neon accents. Use `P2` because ledges, the spanning gear arm, and hanging obstacles occupy surfaces above the abyss floor and occlude one another in a single top-down capture.
